model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for the MistralV0.2-Base model, fine-tuned on different medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms, labeled as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability”, represents a logarithmic scale ranging from approximately -22 to -27, with tick marks at intervals of 1. For each specialty, there are two bars presented side-by-side. The bars are colored light orange and light blue, representing different conditions within each specialty. For the “Cardio” specialty, the orange bar extends to approximately -22.5, while the blue bar extends to approximately -23.5. In “Gastro”, the orange bar reaches approximately -23.2 and the blue bar reaches approximately -24.5. The “Infect” specialty shows an orange bar at approximately -23.8 and a blue bar at approximately -25.5. For “Neuro”, the orange bar is at approximately -24.5 and the blue bar is at approximately -26. The “Obstetrics” specialty has an orange bar at approximately -24.8 and a blue bar at approximately -26.5. Finally, “Pediatrics” shows an orange bar at approximately -23.5 and a blue bar at approximately -27. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
